invariantFindings: Exclusive-pose union exposes individual reachability only. Solver selects exactly one pose/device and never combines exclusive poses in a simultaneous witness.
Flow network shares one source capacity node across devices/exits; independent enumeration validates both full and partial witnesses and non-greedy reassignment.

Ray IDs remain stable through pose selection; repeated target IDs must retain world coordinates. Scene/profile bindings are synthetic consistency checks, explicitly not issuer or calibration authentication.

128-demand finite API explicitly reports fullBaselineEvaluated=false and continuousDomainEvaluated=false; independent full reduction keeps original243x147x18 denominator. No claim partial input completes full-domain coverage.

Unknown calibration, angle, capacity, stale/late/stop-unconfirmed return unsupported with no assignment. Exhausted search returns search_incomplete, never impossibility; success before exhaustive completion is a finite witness only.

Four owner conditions retained. Passive surfaces at image location0; device/source/exit/pose and aperture area remain separate. Few-part full-volume low-glare feasibility is unresolved. Declared sample capacity is not optical throughput or brightness.

All seven acceptance flags stay false in observed outputs, including physicalVisible, lowGlare, continuousWholeDomain, simultaneousPhysicalViewers, independentStop, manufactured and grantsAuthority. No new measured optical/safety threshold or physical assertion is introduced.
